Smartgear 3-in-1 15W Wireless Charging Stand
$15

Smartgear Efficient 3-in-1 wireless charging stand powers three devices at once. This black and silver charging station has a 15W magnetic phone charging pad, a top smartwatch charging module, and a base pad for wireless earbud cases. The item includes a black USB-C cable and a wall power adapter. A red/green LED indicator light is located on the support stem to show charging status. ***Watch/phone and earbuds are NOT INCLUDED! *** you are getting the charging unit only.
